g.text: R11/R12 scale LOAD_OUT to the ADC (12.6V -> 3.1V), C8 filters.

g.desc: R11/R12 scale LOAD_OUT to the ADC (12.6V -> 3.1V), C8 filters.

g.text: Reads the pack voltage while ON, ~0V while OFF.

g.desc: Reads the pack voltage while ON, ~0V while OFF.

g.text: Q3 is the switch: R9 || R10 hold its gate at GND, so it is ON by default.

g.desc: Q3 is the switch: R9 || R10 hold its gate at GND, so it is ON by default.

g.text: C7 slows turn-on (~30-60ms: time for the MCU after a reset). D2 clamps V_GS.

g.desc: C7 slows turn-on (~30-60ms: time for the MCU after a reset). D2 clamps V_GS.

g.text: OFF: OUT_OFF high -> Q1 on -> Q2 on -> R8 pulls Q3's gate to VBAT.

g.desc: OFF: OUT_OFF high -> Q1 on -> Q2 on -> R8 pulls Q3's gate to VBAT.

g.text: R6/R7 keep Q1/Q2 off while the MCU is dead, so the output stays ON.

g.desc: R6/R7 keep Q1/Q2 off while the MCU is dead, so the output stays ON.

g.text: R2 + C3 damp the plug-in spike. U2 is the buck regulator, L1 + C4 its

g.desc: R2 + C3 damp the plug-in spike. U2 is the buck regulator, L1 + C4 its

g.text: inductor and output cap. R3 sets its mode (must be 27.4k, E96).

g.desc: inductor and output cap. R3 sets its mode (must be 27.4k, E96).

g.text: Q4 works as an ideal diode: its body diode

g.desc: Q4 works as an ideal diode: its body diode

g.text: lifts VBAT, R1 holds the gate at GND, so Q4

g.desc: lifts VBAT, R1 holds the gate at GND, so Q4

g.text: turns fully on. Pack reversed: Q4 stays off.

g.desc: turns fully on. Pack reversed: Q4 stays off.

g.text: LED: LED_DRV high -> Q5 pulls Q6's gate low -> Q6 feeds VBAT through R14 to the LED.

g.desc: LED: LED_DRV high -> Q5 pulls Q6's gate low -> Q6 feeds VBAT through R14 to the LED.

g.text: R13/R15 keep the LED off while the MCU is dead.

g.desc: R13/R15 keep the LED off while the MCU is dead.

g.text: Button: SW1 to GND, R16 protects the pin. J4 breaks LED_A/BTN/GND out:

g.desc: Button: SW1 to GND, R16 protects the pin. J4 breaks LED_A/BTN/GND out:

g.text: fit LED1/SW1 here, or leave them unfitted and use the daughter board.

g.desc: fit LED1/SW1 here, or leave them unfitted and use the daughter board.

g.text: U1 BT832 (nRF52832 + antenna). C5/C6 decouple its supply,

g.desc: U1 BT832 (nRF52832 + antenna). C5/C6 decouple its supply,

g.text: Y1 + C1/C2 are the 32kHz crystal, R4 the reset pull-up, J1 the SWD header.

g.desc: Y1 + C1/C2 are the 32kHz crystal, R4 the reset pull-up, J1 the SWD header.
